scope: the STAGED-LANE law arrives at the exchange core: dex-core.cjs + arb-mesh.cjs adopt the same lane check the batch-settle desk already runs (CR-0075 pattern) — STASIS active halts a lane ONLY when that lane is not named in STASIS.stagedLanes.allow; the master brake (active=true) never flips

lanes opened by name: dex-core (the exchange core tick + mesh settle), arb-mesh (the mesh market: measure + draft + settle), dex-activation (the NEW two-sided liquidity ladder desk, this CR's instrument)

the liquidity engine (agents/dex-activation.cjs): every run drafts TWO-SIDED ladder flow around each live pool's mid (both directions — never a direction bet), sized from the measured depth ladder, split across the roster by the mesh mandate law (operator 40% / soldiers the rest), settled through the CORE's own settle law (dust, 5%-depth cap, minOut guard, 10%-wire cap, conservation, attestation) — the engine invents NOTHING and bypasses NOTHING

settle-queue separation (single-writer per file): the activation desk writes agents/dex-activation-queue.json and the core settles it via DEX_SETTLE_QUEUE env — the mesh queue dex-intents.json keeps exactly one writer (the mesh), the activation queue exactly one writer (the desk)

measured visibility: the activation book publishes rolling-24h volume/fees/fills measured from the ledger (never invented); Console giants.mjs merges the core-book truth into the ours row (SAOS DEX) so the owner's giants-table row moves with every beat, honestly labeled internal units

stable-pair surfaces: the two-sided ladder arms on EVERY live pool — peg pools (WSTEEM/STEEM, WSBD/SBD) trade to-peg from both sides, the volatile pool (STEEM/SBD) trades the spread — and the counter-grid lane (CR-0074) stays the keyed surface for chain-side stable pairs (SBD/STEEM, HBD/HIVE) when key material verifies
honesty: the ignition moves INTERNAL SIM LEDGER UNITS on the dex-core book — the units honest-econ labels not-real-money; zero real-chain value, zero keys, zero broadcasts, zero fees in dollars
fee accrual grows in µ units on our pools (LP revenue to treasury) — the giants row labels it מצטבר-פנימי; the DEFiLlama giants stay dollars; the gap row stays honest
real on-chain money remains exactly what money.json measures — this CR changes NOTHING about real money; the keyed churn caps (sovereign-policy limits) stay untouched and owned by the custody lanes
the pools may be tiny (custody measured from FLEET_ACCOUNT liquid balances) — tiny-but-REAL beats big-and-fake; dust rungs refuse honestly (MESH_DUST law)

STASIS stays armed (active=true, mode=staged): the brake can still halt everything by listing removal or halt-all; revocation = remove the lane names from stagedLanes.allow or delete this file — the engine refuses fail-closed on the next tick
revocation: the owner revokes by DELETING this file, removing DEX-ACTIVATION from opens[], or removing the lane names from STASIS.stagedLanes.allow — the desks refuse on the next tick (fail-closed: absent, malformed, or lane-not-allowed all refuse); audited in git history (the CR-0074 artifact law)
